facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (Loi n° 42-2025 of 31 December 2025) sets FCFA 3,500,000,000 for special treasury account no. 10, to modernise and digitise public-finance information systems, fed by customs duties and taxes (FCFA 2,000,000,000 capital, 1,500,000,000 ordinary).
facts.system: Urbanisation des systèmes d'information de gestion des finances publiques, 2026

facts.fact: The account is unchanged at FCFA 3,500,000,000 in 2025 and 2026, so the later year is not higher.
facts.system: Urbanisation des systèmes d'information de gestion des finances publiques, 2025 to 2026
